text:
maria: Support ticket 78923 — customer reports p99 latency for /v1/generate jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.8s after the KV-cache rollout at 02:00 UTC. They attached traces and a dashboard screenshot :frowning:
raj: saw same alert. p99 for /v1/generate up ~8x since ~02:10 UTC. Did we change any eager-loading behavior in the rollout?
devon: the panel they're screenshotting is a 1m rollup with sample-rate applied, could be a rollup artifact. Can we get a request-id? :eyes:
maria: request id `req_0f7a`. Customer included a reproducible prompt that seems to trigger long context KV loads. Pasting repro below.

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-70b","input":"<long prompt... repeated context to 64k>","max_tokens":512}'
```

raj: I repro locally with that prompt against staged rollout. When the KV cache misses we hit a heavy path: full KV hydration + model init on some backends -> p99 ~1.5-1.8s. Cold-paths show `kv-load` steps taking 1.1s.
nina: observability note — our p99 dashboard uses aggregated rollups (1m) with sample-weighting enabled for high-volume endpoints. That can hide or under/over-state tails depending on sampling. The raw histograms might tell a different story.
devon: I pulled the raw t-digest for 02:10 UTC: I see a small tail around 1.6-1.8s but total sample count is low. The rollup quantile in the dashboard actually shows ~300ms for that window — weird, opposite of what the screenshot shows. Need to reconcile panel query vs raw metrics.
maria: customer insists p95 looks fine but p99 is bad in their UI. They want an immediate mitigation and root cause.
raj: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) gate eager KV by prompt-length so very long prompts don't trigger full eager loads; 2) add retry backoff for KV loads; 3) route the customer to the previous model variant or dedicated pool. I can prepare a rollback/playbook.
nina: for the metric disagreement — we'll compare the dashboard PromQL to raw histogram queries. Possible causes: different `rate()` windows, rollup sampling, or a metric ingestion bug. I'll run exact queries against raw TSDB and rollup store.
devon: checklist I ran: - `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/generate\"}[5m])) by (le))` vs - `quantile_over_time(0.99, request_duration_seconds[5m])` — they can diverge when distribution changes. Also confirmed rollup uses sample-rate=10% for this endpoint during peak.
raj: log clip from my repro: `ERROR model-run req=req_0f7a kv-load timed out after 1200ms; falling back to cold path` — so there's a hard timeout we hit when KV takes too long.
maria: customer temporarily rolled back to previous variant and their p99 returned to baseline. They're asking for a timeline and dashboard fix.
devon: found the concrete mismatch: dashboard panel uses the rollup-quantile metric (precomputed) with 1m buckets and sample-rate=10%. Raw histograms (full sampling) show rare long tails that rollups undercount. That explains the inconsistency in their screenshot vs our rollup numbers.
nina: proposed action items:
1) Update the dashboard panel to surface both rollup-quantile and raw-histogram overlay + a small doc note about sampling.
2) Add an alert for `kv_load_timeout_rate > 0.5%` per minute.
3) Gate `kv_eager_load` behind prompt-length threshold and feature-flag; raj to PR and can flip for affected customer.
4) Backfill t-digests for the affected window so we have full fidelity for postmortem.
5) Offer customer config rollback + credits and ask them to test with `?kv=off`.

raj: I'll open the PR to gate `kv_eager_load` and add the rollback playbook now. Will also add a quick runtime flag to disable for a customer.
maria: I'll update the ticket and tell the customer the short-term rollback worked; asking them to test with `?kv=off` and gather their logs. Will offer credit.
alerts-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-78923 assigned to eng-oncall.
devon: I'll file a doc PR explaining rollup vs raw-histogram differences and add example PromQL queries for engineers.
nina: ETA for quick mitigations (dashboard tweak + PR + playbook): ~4h. Full RCA + postmortem tomorrow after backfill.
maria: Thanks team :raised_hands: I'll keep the customer in the loop and close the loop once PRs land.
